name: User can submit the contact form and sees a success message
description: Filling in name, email and message and pressing Send Message shows the confirmation "Thank you! Your message has been sent."

planSteps.description: Open the home page and scroll down to the Contact us section
Type Jane Doe into the Name field
Type jane@example.com into the Email field
Type Hello, I have a question about my order. into the Message field
Verify the button briefly shows Sending… while the message is submitting
Verify a success confirmation appears with the text: Thank you! Your message has been sent.
Verify a Send another message button is shown in place of the form
